mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues falling while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday errand opportunities and in-person shopping trips weaken, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below its current level and RESIDENTIAL staying above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a recent trough substitutes for indoor leisure and retail outings, pulling discretionary visits away from shopping areas and leaving RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from its most recent weekly mean after a three-week decline
failure_condition: PARKS rises above its current weekly mean but RETAIL_REC is not lower within the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains deeply negative while GROCERY_PHARM stays mildly positive, trips are concentrated in essential errands rather than discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -25 while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT remains below -25 and GROCERY_PHARM remains above 0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT reflects mobility frictions or restrictions that spill over into shopping visits, so retail and recreation falls further within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week from a level below -25
failure_condition: TRANSIT drops sharply but RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL rises while WORKPLACES falls, time spent near home rises relative to work-linked trip chains, which suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move lower within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and WORKPLACES remains below its prior month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS during a leisure-heavy seasonal regime draws outing time away from shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS remains above its current four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises and TRANSIT stays flat, demand is shifting toward essential local trips rather than discretionary mall visits, which should hold RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds its current level by 2 points while TRANSIT does not recover
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall or remain below its last-four-week mean within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM increases and TRANSIT fails to improve.

mechanism_narrative: A further deterioration in WORKPLACES signals weaker weekday activity, and because retail trips are partly chained to commuting, RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -18 and remains there for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES stays below -18 for two consecutive weeks.
